docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Bhandarkar’s lectures on the history of India between the Mauryas and the Guptas, from the Greek, Śaka and Kushan kings to the empire of the Guptas (Bombay, 1920). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A peep into the early history of India: from the foundation of the Maurya Dynasty to the downfall of the imperial Gupta Dynasty ; 322 B.C.-circa 500 A.D. · Bhandarkar, Ramkrishna Gopal, Sir, 1837-1925 · 1920, 88 scanned pages. Published 1920; Ramkrishna Gopal Bhandarkar died 1925 and the preface writer H. G. Rawlinson 1950; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
